summary: Produces a scaled value by indexing a lookup table with a monotonically incrementing global counter, multiplying the table entry by a scale factor stored at this+0x8, and storing the product at this+0x14. Returns the new counter value.

operations.description: Index flt_8AAE74 (lookup table at 0x008AAE74) with the low byte of dword_8AAE70 (counter at 0x008AAE70) to read a table entry.
Write the product of the table entry and the scale factor at this+0x8 into this+0x14 (output slot).
Increment dword_8AAE70 (ring-buffer counter) and capture its new value as the return value.
Return the incremented counter value as the result.
